Lauma is a playable Dendro character in Genshin Impact.

As the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, Lauma is a well-respected and wise figure within the group, and trusted by all manners of wildlife. She is immeasurably kind and seeks to find a calm resolution to any conflict; though her steel will reveal itself should people mistake her benevolence for acquiescence.

Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Dendro DMG

Charged Attack
Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps.
When exiting the Spirit Envoy state, Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis will enter cooldown, during which time, Lauma's Charged Attack will be transformed into Spiritcall Prayer: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Lauma plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.

  • When Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis is available, the horns on Lauma's head will glow.
  • While in the Spirit Envoy state:
    • Lauma will continuously move forward at a fixed speed, and cannot Sprint or switch to Walking Mode.
    • She is still affected by Movement SPD increases and decreases.
    • She can still use Plunging Attacks.
    • The state can be exited early by using a Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, or by performing a third consecutive jump (or a second consecutive jump, if the first jump was initiated in midair).

This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. This instance of DMG will not consume any Pale Hymn stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner. This effect can occur up to 8 times during each Frostgrove Sanctuary. When using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, all Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner will be removed. Additionally, when Lauma uses a Normal Attack while she has Pale Hymn stacks, she will consume 1 stack to convert this to deal Dendro DMG equal to 150% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is elevatedElevationSpecial DMG Boost effect. Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a Frostgrove SanctuaryFrostgrove SanctuaryA magical array that protects the Moonchanters and can be summoned by using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko.
The Frostgrove Sanctuary will follow the active character, dealing a single instance of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents within the array every 2s. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG. with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

Tap
Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.

Hold
Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 Verdant DewVerdant DewWhen party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource.
Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset.. Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of Moon SongMoon SongA melody used to weave together hymns. When an Elemental Burst is used, or for a period of time after an Elemental Burst has been used, it can be converted into Pale Hymn stacks that increase the DMG from Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions.
When Lauma consumes Verdant Dew to perform the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, each Verdant Dew consumed will provide Lauma with 1 stack of Moon Song.. Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way.

Additionally, when Lauma's Elemental Skill or attacks from Frostgrove Sanctuary hit an opponent, that opponent's Dendro RES and Hydro RES will be decreased for 10s.

  • When Frostgrove Sanctuary hits at least one enemy, it generates 1.3 Elemental Particles.
    • This particle generation has a cooldown of 3.3 seconds.

Let the wishes of all beings become as moonlight that bathes the earth. Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of Pale HymnPale HymnA hymn passed down by generations of Moonchanters that increases the DMG dealt by Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions.

Lauma can gain Pale Hymn stacks in the following ways:
  • When using her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon.
  • When consuming Moon Song stacks due to using her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon.
  • When the Frostgrove Sanctuary triggers the effect of her Constellation "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight".

When party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.
The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently..
Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has Moon SongMoon SongA melody used to weave together hymns. When an Elemental Burst is used, or for a period of time after an Elemental Burst has been used, it can be converted into Pale Hymn stacks that increase the DMG from Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions.
When Lauma consumes Verdant Dew to perform the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, each Verdant Dew consumed will provide Lauma with 1 stack of Moon Song., or she gains Moon Song within 15s of using her Elemental Burst, she will consume all Moon Song stacks and gain 6 stacks of Pale Hymn for every Moon Song stack consumed. This effect can only be triggered once for each Elemental Burst used, including the 15 seconds following its use.

1st Ascension Passive
For the next 20s after Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, corresponding differing buff effects will be granted depending on the party's Moonsign. The buffs provided by different Moonsign levels cannot stack.

Moonsign: Nascent Gleam
Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG dealt by all nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 15%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.

All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%.
Cleansing for the Spring
4th Ascension Passive
Each point of Elemental Mastery Lauma has will give her the following bonuses:
  • DMG dealt by her Elemental Skill is increased by 0.04%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 32%.
  • The cooldown of her Charged Attack Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis is reduced by 0.02%. The maximum reduction obtainable this way is 20%.
Nature's Chorus
Moonsign Benediction Passive
When a Bloom reaction is triggered by a party member, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Lauma has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Lauma is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
Prayers for the Forest
Utility Passive
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes
  • Preview

Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
Additionally, Lauma appears to have a special affinity with some small animals affected by kuuvahki...

  • Lauma must be in the active party for Prayers for the Forest to take effect.
    • She does not need to be alive to locate local specialties, but does need to be alive to enable the passive's wildlife-related effects.
  • Only one local specialty will be shown on the mini-map at a time.
  • Certain wildlife will behave differently if Lauma is in the party. This only applies in Nod-Krai, and will not work on the same creatures in other regions.
    • Some creatures will have special interactions. A glowing symbol will briefly appear above them when approached.
      • Blunthorn Rhino - These mine and retrieve nearby Rainbowdrop Crystals.
      • Chic Badger - These dig up Fowl and Raw Meat (amount varies).
      • Puffin - These follow the party around.
      • Rimehorn Deer - These heal the party and fully fill their Energy meters.
    • Wildlife in the "Other" category will not startle when approached.
    • Pale-Furred Wolves will not attack when approached. However, they will do so if the player enters combat or stays near them for more than a few minutes.
    • Unlocks exclusive dialogue with certain animal NPCs, such as Pavlov at the Lucky Spin minigame, the finch beside Richeza at the Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse, and the guard animals near Lyylikki.
  • The following Talents are similar to this talent:
    • Nod-Krai Local Specialty:
      • A Light in the Dark (Flins)
      • Miniaturized Detection Sensor (Aino)
      • Prayers for the Forest (Lauma)
    • Other Wildlife:
      • Prayers for the Forest (Lauma)
      • Tailing on Tiptoes (Yaoyao)
      • Thought and Intent, Like Silken Scent (Lan Yan)
      • Yoohoo Art: Silencer's Secret (Sayu)

TitleDescription
Character SummaryLauma is a Dendro support character who enables her party members to trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions and enhances Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions.
After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill , she summons a Frostgrove Sanctuary, which deals continuous Dendro DMG to opponents and lowers their Dendro and Hydro RES.
After Lauma uses her Elemental Burst , she grants nearby party members a fixed number of Pale Hymn stacks, which increase the Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom DMG dealt.
Lunar-Bloom ReactionWhen Lauma is in the party, Bloom reactions triggered by party members are converted to Lunar-Bloom, which provides the party with valuable Verdant Dew on top of the standard reaction effects.
Lauma herself and certain characters can utilize their Talents or consume Verdant Dew to deal Lunar-Bloom DMG to opponents. This DMG can trigger CRIT Hits.

When the Frostgrove Sanctuary attacks opponents, it will deal 1 additional instance of AOE Dendro DMG equal to 185% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.
This instance of DMG will not consume any Pale Hymn stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner.
